decisions.reason: Having remained on its own page through 2024, this older low-marginal-cost API still preserves option value and likely has enough unresolved upside or installed use to justify staying on the market.
As a 2024 launch in a large software firm, the email-to-sms gateway is still in an early learning phase and is relatively inexpensive to keep available while demand uncertainty resolves.

The sms-to-email gateway is also a recent, niche digital offering whose carrying cost is likely low, so keeping it open remains the better real-options choice unless clearer negative evidence emerges.
